name: top_isometry_compact_surjective
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f) : Function.Surjective f
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f), Function.Surjective f
informal: An isometry of a compact metric space into itself is surjective — if y is not in the (closed) range, pick ε > 0 with ball y ε disjoint from range f; the orbit f^[n] y then satisfies dist (f^[m] y) (f^[n] y) = dist y (f^[n-m] y) ≥ ε, so it has no convergent subsequence, contradicting sequential compactness.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), Isometry f → Function.Surjective f
